headline: Day 5: ads add about 7 units a day, almost all in King. Queen, the priority size, has not moved yet; fix its setup before judging its results.
results:
16–19 Oct: 69 units vs a 39-unit baseline (9.7/day × 4) → about 30 extra units, matching the 29 ad orders. Ads look incremental, not replacing organic sales.
Ad spend $1,158 · 29 ad orders · ACoS 46% (break-even 43.7%) · CVR 8.2% (plan 8.6%) · TACoS 13%.
Queen 14 units after ads vs 9 in the 3 days before (3.5/day vs 3.0/day). King 37 vs 13 (9.3/day vs 4.3/day).
Stock carries a Queen push: Queen Graphite 400 units ≈ 250 days at the plan's 1.2 ad orders/day plus current sales; all Queen colours 1,810 units.
observations:
Plan alignment (Joseph's full-year canvas, read Oct 20): every size is on a light push from Oct 19 (Queen 50%, King 35%, Full/Twin 60%), Cal King Oct 26, the head Nov 30; the four head keywords stay on profit until the new order is dated; top-of-search bids were raised to the ranking ceilings on purpose; rival pages, SB, video and Display are deliberate tests. Actions above were revised to fit those rules.
Queen's main keyword 'cooling sheets queen' (organic #68) sits on Conversion with down-only bids and reaches top of search 0.21% of the time. The plan had it as a Ranking push. That, not budget, is why Queen gets so little top-of-search traffic.
Queen rank: 'cooling sheets queen' #76 on 15 Oct → #68 on 20 Oct (target #15). Smaller Queen phrases reached page 1 on most of the last three days ('cooling sheet set queen', 'queen size cooling sheets', 'queen sheet set cooling'). Single-day #3 readings that do not repeat are crawl noise.
Queen converts 1 order on 50 Sponsored Products clicks. That happens 6% of the time at plan CVR, so it is a warning, not yet proof; ads point to the White listing at $87.99 vs the plan's $79.99.
King's result depends on one day (18 Oct). Without it, King ACoS is 87%.
Rival-page ads: 29 clicks, 0 orders, a 17% chance at 6% CVR. Too early to judge, but they also show on unrelated searches (silk, tencel, comforters).
Overlap is small: 6 of 89 search terms were bought by two of our campaigns; Sponsored Brands/Video do not compete in the Sponsored Products auction.
actions:
For Erik and Joseph (Overview → Proposed actions): A1 Queen ads to Queen Graphite; A2 question: switch 'cooling sheets queen' to ranking on the order date; A8 question: who takes top of search on shared Queen searches; A3 tail negatives with A2; A4 branded campaign; A5 unrelated-search negatives; A7 hold Cal King's push to the bridge; A6 plan colours for Full (Cool Grey), Twin and Cal King.
Hold: King to 27 Oct (H1); the plan's live tests to their two-week read (H2). Light-push read for the push-cost calibration by ~Nov 2 (D14).
reasoning:
Setup fixes restore the live plan and do not depend on four days of noisy data.
Pauses and cuts wait for click counts at which 0 orders or high ACoS is unlikely to be chance.
Queen gets the first fix because it is the priority size and its problem is structural (objective, bid type, ad colour), not budget.
King is left alone until a full week confirms it.

headline: Step 2's first full day spent $636 and sold 21 units; Queen had its best day (8). But Queen's own ads have now passed the gate for under-converting (3 orders on 87 clicks), so the Queen ad switch to Graphite (A1) moves to the top.
results:
Oct 20: 21 units ($1,883) vs 14 on Oct 19 and 9.7/day before ads. Ads $636 all types (SP $501, SB $43, video $92); 185 clicks; 7 ad orders so far (still being attributed).
Five full days with ads (16–20 Oct): 90 units = 18.0/day vs 9.7 before ads. 36 ad orders, so 54 units (10.8/day) came without an ad: ads are adding sales, not replacing organic ones.
Ads 16–20 Oct: $1,777, 542 clicks, 36 orders, $3,128 ad sales, ACoS 56.8% (break-even 39.1%), TACoS 22.2%. Oct 19–20 orders are still filling in.
Queen: 8 units on Oct 20 (best day); 4.4/day over 16–20 vs 3.0 before ads. Queen SP campaigns: 87 clicks, 3 orders, $266 (ACoS 101%).
King: 11 units on Oct 20 after 4 on Oct 19; 9.6/day vs 4.3 before ads. King SP: 163 clicks, 15 orders, ACoS 46%.
Full 2.6/day vs 1.3 before ads; Twin 0.8 vs 1.0; Cal King 0.6 vs 0.
FBA stock 21 Oct: 4,352 units (Queen 1,804, King 1,092, Full 597, Twin 426, Cal King 433).
observations:
Step 2 delivered $636 on its first full day: 65% of the ~$980 estimate and 33% of the $1,913 budgets. Impressions doubled (9.3k → 19.3k) but CTR fell from 1.40% to 0.96%. Budgets are still not the limit.
Queen's ads under-convert: 3 orders on 87 SP clicks (3.4%), a 5% chance at the plan's 8.8%. Queen's extra units are mostly non-ad. Most Queen ads show Queen White.
Queen head: the first order on 'cooling sheets queen' came on Oct 20 (10 clicks on 20–21 Oct). Sleephoria took only 1 click there on 20–21 Oct. Organic #68 → #75.
King ranks hold: 'cooling sheets king size' median #3 over 17–21 Oct. 'king sheets cooling' read #3 for four days and #76 on 21 Oct (likely crawl noise; check tomorrow). 'king size cooling sheets' slipped to #40–44.
Queen long-tails stay on page 1: 'cooling sheet set queen' and 'queen size cooling sheets' at #3, 'queen sheets cooling' #7. 'cooling sheets' drifts #26 → #31 → #36.
Rival-page ads: 47 clicks, 0 orders, $105 across five campaigns. That is a 5% chance at 6% CVR, so the test reached its gate before the two-week read.
Best converters so far: King Tail 13 (5 orders on 20 clicks, ACoS 12%), SB collections (2 of 13 and 2 of 12, ACoS 30–34%), King rival video (3 of 16, ACoS 24%).
Changes check (21 Oct): none of the changes proposed on 20 Oct are live yet: A1 Queen ads to Graphite, A4 branded campaign, A5 relevance negatives, A6 smaller-size colours. Queen Graphite, Full Cool Grey, Twin Graphite and Cal King Graphite had $0 ad spend on 20–21 Oct, and irrelevant searches still took paid clicks on 20 Oct.
actions:
Top priority: A1, switch Queen ads to Queen Graphite (evidence now passes the gate; D16).
New A9 (question for Joseph): rival-page test reached its gate early; stop-loss now, or a ~30% bid cut to the two-week read.
Still for approval: A3, A4, A5, A6, A7 (Cal King's plan push date is Oct 26). Questions: A2 (order date expected Oct 23), A8.
Hold: King to 27 Oct (H1); other tests to their two-week read (H2).
reasoning:
Queen and the rival pages now pass the click-count gate. Queen's fix is the ad colour, not a spend cut: its keywords and rank work continue.
King is close to break-even overall (ACoS 46%), so one weak day does not change the hold.
Spend changes wait for the light-push read (~Nov 2), as Joseph's CL-PU8 decided.
Every day A1 waits, Queen SP keeps spending about $53/day (16–20 Oct average) on the Queen White listing, which converts 3 of 87 clicks. The other three are small in money but A4 and A5 are relevance fixes with no evidence gate, so they need no further data.
followups:
Confirm who applies A1, A4, A5 and A6 and by when; re-check the live account in tomorrow's update.
D01 / A2: no change; the order date is not yet confirmed (expected Oct 23). The head campaign is still Conversion, fixed bids, Top-of-Search +50%.
D02 / A1: not applied (ads still Queen White). Gate evidence now met: 3 orders on 87 clicks (D16).
D03 / A3, D04 / A5, D05 / A4, D12 / A6, D13 / A7: not applied; still for approval.
D06 / H1: King 163 clicks, 15 orders, ACoS 46%; holding to 27 Oct.
D07: superseded by D17 / A9 (rival pages 0 on 47 clicks).
D08: Auto 15 clicks, 0 orders, $11.69; low cost, keep.
D09: hold to 27 Oct. D10: sample reached; review after the Graphite switch.
D11: Queen rival video 0 on 23 (15% chance, under the gate); King rival video 3 on 16.
D14: Oct 20 delivered $636 vs the ~$980 estimate; read continues to ~Nov 2.
D15 / A8: Sleephoria eased on 20–21 Oct (1 click); still open for the family page.

headline: Oct 21 was the highest-spend day ($822) and the first day at a net loss (−$143), on 20 units. None of the four proposed changes is live yet, and Queen's own ads now convert 3 of 103 clicks (a 2% chance at plan CVR), so A1 (Queen ads to Graphite) stays the top fix.
results:
Oct 21: 20 units ($1,642) vs 21 on Oct 20 and 9.7/day before ads. Ads $822 all types (SP $603, SB $32, video $186, Display $1); 232 clicks, 15 ad orders, ACoS 65%. Net profit −$143 (Sellerboard): the first loss day.
Six full days with ads (16–21 Oct): 110 units = 18.3/day vs 9.7 before ads. 54 ad orders, so 56 units (9.3/day) came without an ad: organic sales are holding at the pre-ads level and the ads add about 9/day on top.
Ads 16–21 Oct (CLCS4 campaigns): $2,627, 784 clicks, 54 orders, $4,657 ad sales, ACoS 56.4% (break-even 39.1% after refunds), TACoS 27.3%. Earlier days' orders rose as attribution filled in (Oct 20: 7 → 8).
Queen: 6 units on Oct 21 (8 on Oct 20); 4.7/day over 16–21 vs 3.0 before ads. Queen keyword SP campaigns: 103 clicks, 3 orders, $344 (ACoS 130%), with 0 orders on 32 clicks on Oct 21. The search 'cooling sheets queen' took 17 clicks and 1 order on Oct 21.
King: 8 units on Oct 21; 9.3/day vs 4.3 before ads. King keyword SP: 194 clicks, 19 orders, ACoS 45.9% (CVR 9.8%, at plan). King Tail 13: 6 orders on 34 clicks, ACoS 19%.
Full: 6 units on Oct 21 (best day), 3.2/day vs 1.3; 6 orders on 51 SP clicks, ACoS 47%. Twin 0.7/day vs 1.0; Cal King 0.5 vs 0.
FBA stock 22 Oct: 4,340 units (Queen 1,808, King 1,081, Full 591, Twin 427, Cal King 433). Queen Graphite 397, Queen White 194.
observations:
Changes check (22 Oct): still none of A1, A4, A5 or A6 is live. Queen Graphite, Full Cool Grey, Twin Graphite and Cal King Graphite had $0 ad spend on 21–22 Oct; there is no branded campaign among the 65 CLCS4 campaigns; 'bed cooling system' (on the A5 Auto list) took 3 paid clicks ($6.93) on Oct 21.
Spend: Oct 21 reached $822, 84% of the ~$980 step-2 estimate and 46% of the $1,803 total daily budget. Impressions fell (18.9k → 13.8k) but CTR rose (1.03% → 1.68%), so clicks rose 19%.
Queen's ads keep under-converting: 3 orders on 103 keyword clicks is a 2% chance at the plan's 8.8% (5% yesterday). Queen's extra units are still mostly non-ad, and the ads still show Queen White.
Rival pages: 67 clicks, 0 orders, $150 (a 2% chance at 6% CVR). Still waiting on Joseph (A9).
Queen rival video reached its 30-click read: 1 order on 40 clicks, $157, ACoS 178%, above the plan's stop-loss (2× break-even, about 78%). On clicks alone it is not yet proof (16% chance at 8%), so it goes to Joseph (D18 / A10).
Search terms on Oct 21 (Sellerboard): 'cooling sheets' 3 orders on 38 clicks (ACoS 41%), 'cooling sheets full size' 2 on 11 (36%), 'cooling sheets king size' 1 on 22 (84%).
Stock watch: Full Navy Blue (not advertised) has 31 units and sells about 1.1/day, roughly a month left; Sellerboard flags it for reorder. It does not affect the ad SKUs.
Data gap: the command center did not connect today, so organic ranks, Sleephoria's bids and the full search-term report were not refreshed. The rank and search-term tables still show data to the morning of 21 Oct; sales, campaign and stock data come from Sellerboard and are complete to 21 Oct.
Sellerboard reconciliation (22 Oct): Sellerboard's parent B0HN51LPQ1 view excludes 4 CooLinens cooling-sheet SKUs that sit outside the parent: Queen Light Grey, Full Beige, Queen Midnight Black and Twin Cream. On 21 Oct they had 2 units ($162.98) and $90.89 of ad spend ($87.55 on Queen Midnight Black). The tracker counts all cooling-sheet SKUs, so it shows 20 units where the parent view shows 18. Worth checking in Seller Central whether these 4 children are still in the variation family.
SKU check from the Sponsored Products bulk files (18–21 Oct and 21 Oct): every CooLinens campaign has one ad group, and all 274 product ads are enabled. All 25 ranking campaigns have one exact keyword but 3–5 colour SKUs, and the 4 single-keyword conversion campaigns have 5 each, so Amazon spreads each search's spend across colours (A11). On 21 Oct, 12 of the 19 ranking campaigns that spent split it across 2–4 SKUs.
Negatives in the bulk file: Auto has all our exact keywords as negative exact (the launch setup). None of the proposed negatives (A3 tail negatives, A4 'coolinens', A5 relevance negatives and 'sleephoria') is in the file yet.
actions:
Top priority unchanged: A1, switch the Queen ads to Queen Graphite (gate passed; now 3 orders on 103 clicks).
New A10 (question for Joseph): the Queen rival video is above the plan's stop-loss; pause it until the new video (studio 26 Oct) or hold to 26 Oct.
Still needed: A4, A5 and A6 (setup and relevance fixes, no evidence gate), and A3 together with A2. A9 (rival pages) waits on Joseph; review 23 Oct.
Hold: King to 27 Oct (H1); other tests to their two-week read (H2); Cal King push held (A7), plan date Oct 26.
reasoning:
Every day A1 waits, the Queen keyword ads spend about $57/day (16–21 Oct average) on a listing that converts 3 of 103 clicks. Switching the ad colour is the fix, not a spend cut, so the rank work continues.
The Queen video is judged on the plan's own stop-loss because its click count alone is not yet conclusive; it is one of Joseph's tests, so the call is his.
King's ACoS (45.9%) is above the 43.7% hold line but its CVR is at plan, so the 27 Oct read stands.
Oct 21's loss comes from spend rising faster than ad orders. The plan reads spend per rank gained at ~Nov 2 (CL-PU8), so no budget change is proposed before then.
